plugins.name: jira-bug-analyzer
plugins.description: Harness-loop agent that fetches Jira bug tickets via MCP, analyzes attached images/videos, scores against a confidence rubric, verifies on-device via adb, opens PRs, and learns into a shared GitHub memory. Modes: single, multi, manager, team.

plugins.name: learn-app
plugins.description: Trợ lý cho PO lắp app Learn từ Feature Store: đọc spec + Figma, hỏi PO cho rõ, chia plan, viết code theo từng plan, PO duyệt 2 lần (spec đã làm rõ, code cuối), rồi mở PR cho dev. Test chạy riêng bằng plugin android-test-harness.
